sections.title: An American Maritime Company.
body: The world moves at the speed and cost at which people and goods move. Make a dent in that, and you change how the world works.

Navier builds software-defined hydrofoil vessels — one control platform across a family of hulls. Our commercial fleet of N30s has logged 10,000+ operating hours in real service, with vessels running today in the U.S., the Maldives, and beyond.
Commercial deployments make Navier the standing infrastructure of strategic waterways.

blocks.head: ONE HULL, ONE MISSION

sections.title: Commercial Infrastructure First. Defense on Top.
body: We are a dual-use platform company. Commercial fleets carry the production volume — so defense buys at commercial cost and commercial rate, not bespoke-program cost.

Production capacity exists today across U.S. contract yards — Lyman-Morse (Maine) and Seattle for First-of-Class builds and U.S. programs — with California HQ building NavierOS, foils, and new IP. A flagship U.S. shipyard is planned for 2028, sited for Jones Act and U.S. Navy / NATO production.
Unit cost falls with design and volume, not with spec: the Quanta build is engineered −45% against the first-generation N30, line by line.
sections.fine_print: Budgets already moving: US DoD Replicator ≈$1B · Australia A$176M · US Navy FY26 $203M USV R&D. Sourced Aug 2026.
